decisions.reason: The mitred handle family still fits the firm's design-led specification business and likely has moderate carrying costs, so with uncertainty not fully resolved the option is worth keeping open.

This door lever handle line is close to core manufacturing, certification and sales capabilities, which makes retention relatively inexpensive and abandonment unnecessary absent clear negative signals.
The award-winning collection has the strongest positive market signal and brand value in the set, so real-options logic strongly favors continued commitment.
As a finish variant, it is cheap to maintain and broadens architectural choice within existing ranges, so it is sensible to retain unless demand turns plainly weak.
